steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 41
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: The city is a melting pot of cultures.
There's a superstition about walking under ladders.
The old town is a protected cultural heritage site.

steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "melting pot"?

steps.title: Gramática: Present Perfect
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Present Perfect"?
options: If I were you, I would study more.
He told me he would call later.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
